full_name: IMEPLAN Encuesta Origen-Destino 2023 del Area Metropolitana de Guadalajara -- main means of transport to work, by AGEB of residence
description: Household origin-destination survey of the Guadalajara metropolitan area (IMEPLAN, January-May 2023; 17,901 dwellings, 154,662 trips), as published with its expansion factors in the CentroFuturoCiudades/eodgdl repository. A commuter is a surveyed person with at least one trip whose purpose is work (Trabajar); the mode is the main means (Medio del viaje) of that person's first work trip of the day; the person is placed at the AGEB of their dwelling. Counts are expanded with the trip's expansion factor (Ponderador); sampleCommuters is the unexpanded number of surveyed commuters (a few per AGEB: the survey is designed for its 64 centralidades, so AGEB shares are noisy).

features.definition: Persons with at least one work trip on the survey day (expanded).
Surveyed persons with at least one work trip (not expanded): the sample behind the shares.

features.original_name: CAMION O AUTOBUS + MI MACRO + TREN LIGERO + Linea 1/2/3 Sitren + Servicio suburbano + Taxi colectivo
features.definition: Commuters whose main means to work is a bus, the Mi Macro BRT, the light rail (Tren Ligero), a SITREN feeder line, a suburban service or a shared taxi.

features.original_name: CAMION O AUTOBUS + Linea 1/2/3 Sitren + Servicio suburbano + Taxi colectivo
features.definition: Commuters by bus, SITREN feeder line, suburban service or shared taxi.
Commuters by the Mi Macro bus rapid transit (Macrobus, Mi Macro Periferico).
Commuters by the light rail (Tren Ligero lines 1-4).
Commuters by private car, as driver or passenger.
Commuters cycling to work (own bicycle or the Mi Bici bike share).
Commuters in transport organised by the employer.

features.original_name: Taxi + Taxi plataforma + Mototaxi + Transporte escolar (particular) + Transporte informal
features.definition: Commuters by taxi, ride-hailing, motorcycle taxi, school transport or informal transport.
